title: Parts import with a blank Manufacturer keeps the part's manufacturer
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IMPMFR-01) is tracked at {Location-A} with manufacturer {Manufacturer-A} (for example the first manufacturer offered) and Min 1.
  • Parts import file {File-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IMPMFR.csv) has one row for {Part-A} with the Manufacturer cell blank and Min 2.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings → Data Import → Inventory, upload {File-A} and run the import.
  2. Open {Part-A} on Parts → Inventory.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The import finishes without errors.
  • Step 2: Manufacturer still reads {Manufacturer-A}, and Min reads 2, which shows the import did run.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-E8a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows the import.
